contract.precondition: User.allInstances()->exists(u:User | u.UserID = uid and fee >= u.OverDueFee and Loan.allInstances()->exists(l:Loan | l.LoanedUser = u and l.IsReturned = true and l.OverDueFee > 0.0 and l.DueDate.isBefore(Today)))
